title: The Family That Refused to Break — Part 9

series.summary: The destined bond turns Hakari's mother from enemy into family, and the night that nearly broke the Rentarou family ends with it bigger and stronger than ever.

segments.voiceover_text: That single look changes everything. The mother who locked Hakari away now carries a destined bond of her own — with her daughter's boyfriend. The war for Hakari does not end in battle. It ends with the family growing by one very flustered queen.

Because this was never about stealing a girl back. It is about a boy whose heart keeps making room — for Hakari, Karane, Shizuka, Nano, Kusuri, and now, unbelievably, Hahari too. One hundred girlfriends. And this wild night was truly, honestly only the beginning.
